Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly identify the work referenced in footnote 397 of Federico Lauria's 2014 dissertation. Instead of finding the specific citation in the dissertation (which is "The Liver Is the Cock's Comb" by Arshile Gorky), the agent incorrectly identified the dissertation's own title, "The Logic of the Liver," as the referenced work.
